place.title: Place {ref} (push button)
place.text: Press the button {ref} into holes {holes}, so it bridges the center channel.

why: {ref} is an input: pressing it joins its two pairs of legs, and the Pico notices the change on the pin it's wired to.

wire.ground: When {ref} is pressed, it connects its pin to ground, so the pin reads 0 (LOW). The rest of the time the Pico's internal pull-up makes it read 1.
